subject: prd/installer
statement: When init or repair runs, the system shall converge the repository onto the pinned release manifest per ownership class: writing engine-verbatim files byte-exact, regenerating generated files, and validating repo-owned files against their closed schema without rewriting them.
rationale: converge is the product's core semantic
fit_criterion: injected engine-file drift is repaired byte-exact; repo-owned edits survive byte-exact; generated files regenerate; validation failures are named
